messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Amlodipine besylate is a prescription medicine.
It is used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension).
It is used to prevent certain types of angina (chest pain).
It belongs to a class of medications called calcium channel blockers.
Amlodipine besylate works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels.
This causes blood to flow more easily.
This improves blood pressure.
Amlodipine besylate controls angina chest pain by increasing the supply of blood to the heart.
If taken regularly, this medicine controls chest pain.
It does not stop chest pain once it starts.
Your doctor may prescribe a different medication to take when you have chest pain.
Amlodipine is also used alone or in combination with other medicines to treat high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults and children at least 6 years old.
Lowering blood pressure may lower your risk of a stroke or heart attack.
Amlodipine besylate is available as:
Amlodipine 5 mg tablets (Norvasc)
Amlodipine 10 mg tablets (Norvasc)
Amlodipine 2.5 mg tablets (Norvasc)
Amlodipine 1 mg/mL solution (Norliqva)
Triples: [["Amlodipine besylate", "is a", "prescription medicine"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "treats", "high blood pressure"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "treats", "hypertension"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "used to prevent", "angina"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "belongs to drug class", "calcium channel blockers"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "has mechanism of action", "relaxing and widening the blood vessels"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "causes", "blood to flow more easily"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "improves", "blood pressure"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "controls angina chest pain by", "increasing the supply of blood to the heart"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "controls chest pain when", "taken regularly"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "does not stop", "chest pain once it starts"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "may be prescribed with", "different medication for chest pain"], ["Amlodipine", "treats", "high blood pressure"], ["Amlodipine", "treats", "hypertension"], ["Amlodipine", "used in adults and children", "at least 6 years old"], ["Amlodipine", "used alone or in combination with", "other medicines"], ["Amlodipine", "lowers blood pressure may lower risk of", "stroke"], ["Amlodipine", "lowers blood pressure may lower risk of", "heart attack"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "has dosage form", "5 mg tablets"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "has dosage form", "10 mg tablets"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "has dosage form", "2.5 mg tablets"], ["Amlodipine besylate", "has dosage form", "1 mg/mL solution"], ["Amlodipine 5 mg tablets", "has brand name", "Norvasc"], ["Amlodipine 10 mg tablets", "has brand name", "Norvasc"], ["Amlodipine 2.5 mg tablets", "has brand name", "Norvasc"], ["Amlodipine 1 mg/mL solution", "has brand name", "Norliqva"]]
Relations: ["belongs to drug class", "causes", "controls angina chest pain by", "controls chest pain when", "does not stop", "has brand name", "has dosage form", "has mechanism of action", "improves", "is a", "lowers blood pressure may lower risk of", "may be prescribed with", "treats", "used alone or in combination with", "used in adults and children", "used to prevent"]
Answer:

completion:
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.  
causes: The subject drug leads to or results in the effect or condition specified by the object entity.  
controls angina chest pain by: The subject drug manages angina chest pain through the mechanism specified by the object entity.  
controls chest pain when: The subject drug manages chest pain under the condition specified by the object entity.  
does not stop: The subject drug is ineffective in halting the condition or event specified by the object entity.  
has brand name: The subject drug formulation is marketed under the brand name specified by the object entity.  
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.  
has mechanism of action: The subject drug exerts its effect through the mechanism specified by the object entity.  
improves: The subject drug enhances or positively affects the condition specified by the object entity.  
is a: The subject entity is classified as or is an instance of the object entity.  
lowers blood pressure may lower risk of: The subject drug, by lowering blood pressure, may reduce the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.  
may be prescribed with: The subject drug may be used in conjunction with the medication specified by the object entity.  
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.  
used alone or in combination with: The subject drug is administered either by itself or together with the entity specified by the object entity.  
used in adults and children: The subject drug is indicated for use in individuals of the age group specified by the object entity.  
used to prevent: The subject drug is used to prevent or reduce the likelihood of the condition specified by the object entity.
